name: Documents
summary: Reads a document you give her — PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OpenDocument, EPUB, web pages, spreadsheets, notes and code — and changes text in Word, Markdown, text and CSV files.

requires.why: To open the document you attached, or one you point it at.
To save an edited copy beside a document in a folder you opened, or change the file itself when you ask.
If something here can read the words in a picture, to use it for a scan. Without it, a scan is refused.

settings.label: Most characters to send
settings.hint: A long book is bigger than any model can read at once. Past this it is cut, and the text says where.
